title: The Lilac Puffer Christmas Tree Farm Outfit
description: A Christmas tree farm outfit from Walmart: a pink, navy and green plaid shacket, a lilac puffer vest, light wash wide leg jeans, tan lug Chelsea boots, a pink pom beanie and a cognac camera crossbody.
intro: Every year we go cut our own tree, and every year someone ends up in sneakers, soaked to the ankle, blaming the dog. Not this year. This is the outfit for dragging a Fraser fir across a muddy field and still looking cute in the photo by the wagon: a plaid shacket in pink, navy and green, a lilac puffer vest on top for the wind, wide leg jeans, lug sole boots that can handle the mud, a pink pom beanie and a little crossbody for the cash box. Hot cocoa after is not optional.

sections.heading: The layers
paragraphs: The Time and Tru women's plaid button front shacket in Multi Plaid, the Time and Tru core puffer vest in Dusty Orchid, and the Time and Tru wide leg jeans in Light Wash with a 31 inch inseam.

sections.heading: The finishing pieces
paragraphs: The Time and Tru lug Chelsea boots in Tan, the REDESS acrylic pom pom beanie in Pink, and the Time and Tru Addie camera crossbody in cognac brown.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The tree farm, the hallway and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
